Actually $ESMT and my legacy memory names held up better than the rest of the AI trade.

This was more of a durability/PSMC hike sensitivity type thesis, but... we got durability support now from brand new commentary yesterday:

- ESMT expected tightness on their legacy memory products through 2028 or longer
- Further Q4 price increases... with the operating performance is expected to be better than the third quarter
- Supply shortfall exceeding 30%

Source: Digitimes TW

So you have a $2.15B MC company that made $107M net income a month (annualized $1.28B earnings a year) from July earnings... 

With future price hikes and likely tightness lasting through 2028 onward.

posts.zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit：$NVDA黃仁勳對CNBC表示2029年前記憶體供過於求不太可能，因為記憶體永遠可用得更多，並以數據中心使用LPDDR為例，反駁韓國媒體2029年將陷入紅海的看法。
posts.text:
$NVDA Jensen Huang: Surplus of memory supply is unlikely by 2029. 

The CNBC question referenced a Korean newspaper opinion on $KOSPI / Samsung / SK Hynix that predicted "new supply will leave the memory sector a red ocean in 2029."

"One of the things that's really great about memory is that you can always use more of it", Jensen said, citing LPDDR usage in DCs.  And responded "I don't think so" in terms of possibilities of oversupply in 2029. 

Just my personal opinion, Nvidia probably has the most visibility in the entire industry. 

Especially around supply procurement and emerging capacity, given they're the ones leading all the architectural shifts. 

On durability, you have Samsung already allocated majority of capacity into 2031 from SED and hyperscalers like $GOOGL are already reportedly securing memory LTAs into 2035 from KeyBanc. 

Yet there's endless "it's all over" sentiment on memory now. I'd probably trust Jensen's opinion here.

This $CBRS daily was probably one of my fav setups this month and has been holding prior bar highs for over a week. (I had highlighted it in real-time so don’t yell at me “hindsight”)

daily.brief: 今日討論集中在$SPCX強勁財報同Musk談$TSLA合併，60則帖文來自29個帳號，看好觀點55個遠多於看淡8個。共同看好最齊心係$SPCX（8個帳號），$CRWV則有明顯分歧。
daily.full:
共識

共同看好以$SPCX最突出，8好0淡，13次提及。財報雙重超預期，EPS $0.35對預估$0.13，收入$14.57B對預估$12.87B。@howardlindzon直指「安靜的小豬……我是說空頭」（原帖）。@michaelsikand提到SpaceX SI收入增長830%，已超過Starlink，算力預計從目前1.7 GW近乎翻倍至年底可能達3 GW（原帖）。@StockSavvyShay引公司稱新AI算力部署回收期少於一年，定價現已超過每瓦$50，這對$NBIS、$CRWV和$IREN是強勁信號（原帖）。

$TSLA 5好0淡，8次提及。焦點全在合併傳聞。@KobeissiLetter報Elon Musk表示SpaceX、$SPCX與Tesla已成立特別委員會討論潛在合併，認為在超智能奇點中合併有很大好處（原帖）。@amitisinvesting引Musk原話：「不保證會發生，但我認為合併兩家公司有很大好處……機器人、芯片設計、連接性……我認為這是個好主意」（原帖）。

$AMZN 3好0淡。@StockSavvyShay指AWS預計將接收約50億美元的$NVDA GB300機架，每月交付約30億美元，甚至在數據中心有足夠電力之前就提前確保GPU（原帖）。@OptionsMike說今日$AMZN仍然看起來不錯（原帖）。

$UNH 2好0淡。@TheTranscript_引UnitedHealthcare CEO稱AI已在減少臨床醫生行政工作量，AI輔助圖表摘要擴展到超過40%受僱臨床醫生，減少圖表審查時間33%（原帖）。

共同看淡

今日沒有共同看淡的標的。

分歧

$CRWV 2好2淡，5次提及。@StockSavvyShay從$SPCX回收期少於一年、定價超過每瓦$50看出客戶願意為快速交付的AI算力支付溢價，對$CRWV是正面信號。但@KeithMcCullough擔心槓桿正在加速損害，指出$CRWV從#MOAB峰值下跌67%，成交量101M對平均31M（原帖）。@Mr_Derivatives則看到盤後$66.35，買了一小批作波段（原帖）。

$GOOG同樣2好0淡。@michaelsikand假設如果$GOOG從OpenAI、Claude、Muse等撤銷Gmail和Calendar的API存取權限，可能一舉佔領整個代理式AI市場（原帖）。@Beth_Kindig引花旗預計這四家支出將從明年合計1.02萬億美元上升到2030年的1.62萬億美元，點名$MSFT $AMZN $GOOG $META（原帖）。

$SPCX 3好1淡，9次提及。@michaelsikand形容$SPCX將成為我的車，透過Grokbot成為公司勞動力、互聯網、手機供應商、Uber司機，透過Optimus成為廚師和清潔工，是的這還沒被定價（原帖）。@SawyerMerritt引摩根士丹利Adam Jonas筆記，指出讓他人為SpaceX最終用於訓練自身機器人的計算基礎設施付費是個好主意，將新雲端建設視為融資策略（原帖）。
